notes.title: KAZ v0.1.8
notes.content:
[h2]Kaz Update v0.1.8 – [b]More Items, More Chaos, and the New Curse Meter![/b][/h2][p]Hey speedsters![/p][p]This week, we’ve got some spicy new updates that are about to turn your runs upside-down. The biggest? [b]We’ve dropped a whole new batch of items[/b] into the game. That’s right—your builds are about to get wilder, crazier, and a [i]lot[/i] more unpredictable. Whether you’re chasing the perfect synergy or just trying to break your old high score, there’s never been a better time to experiment (and brag about it).[/p][p]But wait, there’s more—let’s talk about CURSES.[/p][h3]The Curse Meter: Feel the Pressure[/h3][p]We heard you. The old “get a penalty every 3 rounds” system? Gone. Say hello to the [b]Curse Meter[/b].[/p][list][*][p][b]How does it work?[/b] Every match, your Curse Meter creeps up, just a little.[/p][/*][*][p]Some enemies—especially those nasty traps—will spike your curse way faster if you’re not careful.[/p][/*][*][p]Fill the meter, and… let’s just say you’ll regret it.[/p][/*][/list][p]Now, instead of waiting for a random malus every few rounds, you can see the pressure building up, match after match. It’s tense. It’s stressful. It’s exactly what Kaz needed.[/p][h3]Why did we do this?[/h3][p]We wanted curses to feel like a real threat, not just a surprise slap every once in a while. The new system rewards careful play, and it makes those clutch dodges and big risk moves even more satisfying.[/p][p]And with all the new items? Trust us, the combos (and disasters) are going to get wild.[/p][hr][/hr][p]That’s all for now! Jump in, try to break the game, and let us know what you think on [url="https://discord.gg/rWu7Emjsp3"]Discord[/url] or tag us on socials. Your feedback helps us keep Kaz immediate, intense, and just the right amount of evil.[/p][p]And remember:
[b]If you lose, it’s [i]definitely[/i] because of the Curse Meter. We all know it. 😉[/b][/p][p][b]Stay fast, stay cursed![/b][/p][p]— Kalinarm[/p]
